title: Unique ordinary integral-support comparison
statement: In the setting of [def-pur-integral-support-comparison-data], there exists exactly one Ordinary record: the section-normalized open and proper push comparisons and their open inverse-image and extension-by-zero Hom transposes. This statement involves only ordinary module functors, with no chain maps or derived comparisons.

source.place: Outer Hom comparisons and final unit/counit paragraph; canonical comparison specified by Zheng Constructions 4.1 and 5.15, Lemma 4.10, and the universal-unit characterization in integralExceptionalComparison_characterization.

proof.text: On sequence-site direct-image sections the coordinate map is the identity, is linear, and commutes with every quotient transition. Express this map using rightEvaluation and rightUnderlying to obtain the two ordinary push comparisons; their inverses are the inverse section identifications.

Transport the inverse/direct adjunction through the coordinate equivalences. Uniqueness of the left adjoint gives openPull with its stated transpose equation. Transport extension/restriction a second time to get openExtension with the displayed Hom-transpose equation.

Cancel rightUnderlying and rightEvaluation and use section extensionality to identify push maps in any two records. Evaluate the two transpose equations on identity morphisms to identify the other comparison components; naturality and proof irrelevance identify the Ordinary records.
